changes.to: Issue #1 (2026-11-24): Asimov's Sayabot page gives features only — wheels on flat floors, arms with gestures, built-in robot camera, face recognition, obstacle detection, teleoperation, tablet display — and no height, weight, speed, DoF, battery or payload figure. Optional fingerprint/thermal-camera items are options, so only the standard camera is listed. Reseller/aggregator figures (e.g. IndiaMart 40-50 kg, 160 cm) were not used. Status taken from the maker's product page, which offers the robot with customization.
Wheeled Indian multi-purpose humanoid-style service robot for reception, guidance, banking, healthcare and security; the maker lists features but no mechanical specs.
